name: Thoracic Outlet Syndrome (TOS)
summary: The thoracic outlet is the space between the collarbone and the first rib through which the brachial plexus, subclavian artery and subclavian vein pass to the arm. Compression can occur at three sites: between the scalene muscles, between the clavicle and first rib, and under the pectoralis minor.

looksLike: Diffuse arm pain, heaviness, tiredness and tingling, often in the C8 to T1 area.
Worse with overhead work, carrying bags, sleeping with arms overhead.
Neck, shoulder and upper chest pain.
Neurological examination is often normal in neurogenic TOS; wasting of hand muscles is uncommon but serious.
redFlags: Sudden arm swelling and blue colour
Cold, white, painful fingers, absent pulse
Smoker with shoulder pain, Horner signs, weight loss
firstSteps: Positional arm symptoms, normal neuro exam, positive provocation, supraclavicular tenderness: working diagnosis neurogenic TOS.
Start conservative care for at least several months before surgical opinion.

sections.title: G. RED FLAGS AND URGENT CONDITIONS

rows: Sudden arm swelling and blue colour
Cold, white, painful fingers, absent pulse
Smoker with shoulder pain, Horner signs, weight loss

steps: **Cervical root or peripheral entrapment better explains findings?** Use that pathway.
**Positional arm symptoms, normal neuro exam, positive provocation, supraclavicular tenderness:** working diagnosis neurogenic TOS.
**Start** conservative care for at least several months before surgical opinion.

items: First rib mobilisation (caudal glide) when the first rib is elevated and stiff: supine or sitting, therapist's hand on the first rib above the clavicle, gentle downward glide.
Gentle scalene and pectoralis minor soft-tissue work for comfort.
Neural mobilisation using sliders, not tensioners, if irritable (Vol 13 Ch 5).

rows: Scapular elevation and upward rotation (shrugs with arms slightly abducted, wall slides)
Pectoralis minor stretch in a doorway

blocks.text: Activity modification: avoid prolonged overhead work and heavy shoulder bags; sleep with arms below shoulder level.
Not routinely indicated. Heat for comfort.
Roos test duration, symptom frequency, QuickDASH, overhead work time.

items: **Which TOS type is most common?** Neurogenic.
**Why is a positive Adson test alone weak evidence?** Pulse reduction occurs in many people without symptoms.
**What is an emergency in TOS?** Signs of venous thrombosis or arterial occlusion.
**What should you rule out in a smoker with shoulder pain and a drooping eyelid?** Pancoast tumour.
**Why use sliders before tensioners?** Sliders move the nerve with less tension, so they are less provocative.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Classify TOS by type.
Perform the Roos and Adson tests and interpret them cautiously.
Distinguish TOS from radiculopathy and peripheral entrapments.
Plan conservative management.

sections.A: Thoracic outlet hansli aur pehli pasli ke beech ki jagah hai jahan se nerves aur khoon ki naliyan baazu mein jaati hain. Teen jagah dabao ho sakta hai.
sections.B: Baazu mein phaila hua dard, bhaari-pan, thakan aur jhunjhunahat, khaas kar haath upar kar ke kaam ya bojh uthane par.
sections.C: Kaun si position symptoms laati hai, baazu mein sujan ya rang badalna, aur thandi safed ungliyan: yeh sawaal nerve ya khoon ki nali ka farq batate hain.
sections.D: Posture, sujan, rang, haath ki muscles ka sukhna, dono baazuon ki nabz aur BP, gardan ka screen aur neuro exam.
sections.E: In tests mein kai sehatmand log bhi positive aate hain, is liye inhein poori tasveer ke saath parhein. Roos test mein haath upar rakh kar mutthi kholi-band ki jati hai.
sections.F: Radiculopathy, cubital tunnel aur carpal tunnel isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Achanak baazu ki sujan aur neela rang, thandi safed ungliyan aur nabz na hona, ya barhti kamzori: emergency ya urgent referral.
sections.H: Khoon ki nali ke signs hon to foran refer. Agar gardan ya doosri nerve behtar wajah ho to woh raasta. Warna position se aane wale symptoms aur positive tests: TOS.
sections.I: Pehli pasli ki neeche ki taraf halki glide, aur scalene aur pectoral muscles par halka kaam.
sections.J: Kandhe upar uthane wali exercises, diaphragm se saans, aur pectoralis minor stretch.
sections.K: Machines aam taur par zaroori nahi; garmi aaraam ke liye.
sections.M: Roos test ka waqt, symptoms kitni baar, QuickDASH aur haath upar kar ke kaam ka waqt.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Sab se aam qism neurogenic TOS hai.
